review: MESH CLASS metadata and version evidence

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD 2010 DXF Reference
supports: SUBDIVISION uses the AcDbSubDMesh subclass and documents the base cage, crease, and property-override group-code family.
Generic CLASSES group-code meanings include record/class/app names, proxy flags, instance count, was-a-proxy, and entity flag.
does_not_establish: An authoritative exact CLASS tuple for AcDbSubDMesh.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD 2013 DXF Reference
supports: MESH uses the AcDbSubDMesh subclass and documents its base cage and related group-code family.
does_not_establish: AC1032 acceptance or exact CLASS tuple.

sources.title: ezdxf 1.4.4 MESH internals
supports: Documentation states MESH was introduced in R13/R14.
The example represents MESH and AcDbSubDMesh fields.
does_not_establish: An R13/R14 writer or verified native sample.

sources.title: ezdxf 1.4.5 MESH API
supports: ezdxf documents DXF R2000 / AC1015 as its required export version.
does_not_establish: Historical format introduction; an implementation export minimum is not necessarily a format minimum.

sources.title: LibreDWG generated MESH field census
supports: Generated census labels a MESH entity from test/test-data/2004/Surface.dxf and shows AcDbEntity plus AcDbSubDMesh fields.
does_not_establish: The listed file's header, hash, producer, CLASS tuple, or whether the census reflects original input versus converted/generated data.

sources.title: Autodesk DXF 2010 generic CLASS schema
supports: CLASS group codes 1, 2, 3, 90, 91, 280, and 281 describe record name, C++ class name, application name, proxy capabilities, instance count, was-a-proxy, and entity status respectively.
does_not_establish: Normative SubDMesh application string or proxy capability value.

sources.title: ACadSharp issue #1038 and v3.6.12 release notes
supports: Historical report showed a MESH/AcDbSubDMesh DXF entity displayed as ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY with ObjectDBX Classes application text.
Release notes say PR #1067 updated mesh version, DXF asserts, and edge-crease handling.
does_not_establish: Exact fixed CLASS tuple or current-release native application acceptance.

sources.title: ACadRust class registry
supports: Implementation claims its R2013 default class registry matches AutoCAD output and gives MESH/AcDbSubDMesh proxy flags 4095 and a descriptive application string.
does_not_establish: Independent/native validation of that claim in this review.

versioned_names.pre_AC1024: Unqualified; retain current compatibility behavior while auditing exact sample provenance
versioned_names.AC1032: Implementation currently inherits MESH; keep profile unqualified pending native or version-specific reference sample

reconciliation.class_tuple: Local SCENEOE/1025 tuple is tested only as a serializer invariant. Generic Autodesk schema does not define it; peer artifacts differ. Native acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
reconciliation.old_sample: LibreDWG Surface.dxf could not be fetched in the review tool; no header, hash, producer or original-source confirmation was available.
